title: Your Listing Copy Now Reaches the Buyer
summary: The short line you write on your own listings now appears on the vehicle page, in a Purchase details box beneath location and delivery. Your own words about a unit reach the buyer who is reading about it.
body_markdown:
AI summary


The short line you write on your own listings now appears on the vehicle page, in a Purchase details box beneath location and delivery. Your own words about a unit reach the buyer who is reading about it.


Most dealers keep a short line on their own listings. "Drive it home this week, financing decided in minutes." It is written to sell the unit, in the dealer's own voice, and it used to stop at the dealer's own website.


##


What changed


That line now appears on the vehicle page, in a Purchase details box under the location and delivery cards. A buyer reads it beside the details they are already weighing, rather than never seeing it at all.


##


Your voice, beside ours


A lot of what a buyer reads on a listing is assembled for you. This part is not. It carries your terms, your promise and your reason to trust the unit, in the words you chose.


##


Nothing to switch on


If you already keep a blurb on your listings, it comes across with the rest of the listing details. If you do not keep one, it is worth writing: the line now does work on the vehicle page instead of sitting on your own site alone. A listing without one reads exactly as it does today.


##


Where to find it


Open any vehicle's listing on your storefront and scroll to Purchase details, beneath the Location and Delivery cards.


## Frequently asked questions
